name: Paul Vidal
office: Palos Verdes Peninsula Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Paul Vidal is a healthcare company CEO and parent running for the Palos Verdes Peninsula Unified School District board. He is a Naval Academy graduate and former Navy pilot.

sentences.text: Paul Vidal is a healthcare company CEO and parent running for the Palos Verdes Peninsula Unified School District board.
He is a Naval Academy graduate and former Navy pilot.

items.text: His candidate statement supports protecting academic rigor, supporting teachers, transparent budgets, and keeping politics out of classrooms. At a summer picnic of the Palos Verdes Democrats, he stressed resisting book bans and discrimination, along with fiscal responsibility, educational quality, and inclusion.
